symptom: A state-changing connector action targeted the wrong resource and briefly changed unrelated GitHub state.
rootCause: Mutation dispatch occurred before tool action, resource type, exact identifier and requested intent were matched as one fail-closed precondition.
failedApproach: Treating a connector capability match as sufficient authorization to mutate without revalidating the concrete resource and intent immediately before the call.
requiredAction: Before every connector mutation, verify action, resource type, exact identifier and user intent together. If any field is unresolved or mismatched, do not execute. After an accidental mutation, restore the exact prior state and perform one bounded readback.
prevention: Connector discovery and connector mutation are separate phases. Discovery may identify a capable tool; execution still requires an exact resource-and-intent routing check.
regression: No state-changing connector call may execute when resource type, identifier, action or requested intent is unresolved or mismatched.

recovery.onAccidentalMutation: restore exact prior state once, read back once, record the fingerprint and root cause, then stop retrying the wrong route
